repository.name: agent-threat-rules
repository.description: Open detection-rule standard for AI agent security threats — like Sigma, but for AI agents. Executable, testable rules for prompt injection, tool poisoning, context exfiltration and MCP attacks. Merged into open-source projects at Microsoft, Cisco, Gen Digital, MISP and FINOS. MIT-licensed.
